definitions.standard: A subatomic particle of about the same mass as a proton but without an electric charge, present in all atomic nuclei except those of ordinary hydrogen.
definitions.simple: A tiny, invisible particle that lives in the center of an atom with protons. It acts like glue holding the nucleus together, and it has absolutely no charge!
definitions.scientific: A neutral hadron composed of one up quark and two down quarks. It resides in the nucleus and contributes to the atomic mass without affecting the atomic number.

common_misconceptions: Neutrons are negatively charged. (No, that's electrons. Neutrons are NEUTRAL).
tutor_context.tutor_hint: Remember 'N' for Neutron and 'N' for Neutral!
